entities.summary: Jordi Grimau i Gragera is a Spanish former professional basketball player. Playing for many teams throughout his career, Grimau competed in the main categories of the Spanish basketball league system, including Liga ACB, LEB Oro, LEB Plata and Liga EBA. Grimau retired in 2024.
